body:
Follow-up to `sleeping-ledger`, which left wake declarations exogenous.

- Exact leave-one-out identity: the ledger transfer to module i is `ηW_A(1−p_i)S_i`.
- Post-hoc sleeping is an option, not a skill: expected gain `ηp_Bθ(1−θ)/2` (best 1/8). It takes the market in ~130 rounds while the router's loss is unchanged.
- Ex-ante commitment makes the same behaviour a real saving (`s·g`).
- The deterring sleeping tax `ηp_B/2` is a fixed-share rate that destroys the frozen ledger.

9 stdlib-only tests pass; README and portfolio page updated. MIT.
